artifact_observations.reasoning: The background features a repeating pattern of architectural-style drawings on tiles. The perspective lines of these drawings are inconsistent and warp unnaturally near the edges. The texture looks like a low-resolution print pasted onto a 3D surface rather than real tiles, exhibiting AI-generated 'pattern smearing'.

The hand on the left has distorted anatomy. The fingers appear to merge into the white object being held without clear boundaries. The thumb structure is ambiguous and seems to lack a distinct nail or joint definition. The skin texture is overly smooth and waxy, lacking pore detail.

The iron stands vertically on its heel. The contact point with the ground lacks a realistic shadow or physical grounding. It appears to float slightly above the patterned surface, or the shadow is incorrectly painted as a dark smear rather than a cast shadow.

The black fabric has no discernible weave or texture. It appears as a flat, void-like shape with soft, undefined edges where it meets the hand and background, suggesting a failure in material rendering.
